evidence: Carries the IPC label and adds Cap'n Proto proxy definitions, serialization logic, and libmultiprocess subtree updates across src/ipc/.
rationale: Exposing the Chain interface over IPC directly advances the IPC project's central goal of running bitcoin-wallet in a separate process (#10102). It provides both an external stable API and an internal unstable interface, unblocking external consumers and indexes demonstrated by multiple reviewers without freezing internal wallet methods.
